proposition: Melvin-Koushki holds, against both Corbin and Lewisohn, that Ibn Turka's confessional position is best described as Shiʿi-Sunnism or imamophilism, a normal feature of the age, rather than as Shiʿi or Sunni.

mediation.note: MK's own term and reading; he himself calls the confessional position ambiguous.
